Send a one-time sign-in link (15 min) to a field worker's e-mail.

Always ``202`` (unknown, inactive and other-tenant addresses included), so the answer
reveals no accounts.

post.description:
Spend a magic link: start a session on this device, gated by the PIN set here.

The session's refresh token then works only through `/auth/pin/unlock`.

Unlock a PIN-gated session: the device's refresh cookie + the PIN rotate the tokens.

Wrong PINs lock the session progressively; the 10th wrong PIN revokes it.

schema.description: The refresh token (httpOnly cookie, never JS)

post.description:
Rotate: the refresh cookie is spent and a new pair is issued. Reuse revokes the session.

The new refresh token keeps the session's end (sign-in + 12 h); after it, sign in again.

FilterGroup-Output.description: ``{op: and|or, conditions: [...]}``; conditions are conditions or nested groups.

GroupBy.description: Group rows by ``columns`` (outermost first), with aggregates and a totals row.

JobCreate.description: ``POST /jobs``: a kind registered with ``api=True`` and its payload.

JobRead.description: ``GET /jobs/{id}``: the job's state, as last written by the worker.

MagicLinkRedeemRequest.title: MagicLinkRedeemRequest
MagicLinkRedeemRequest.description: Spend a magic link and set the PIN that will unlock the new session on this device.

ModuleState.title: ModuleState
ModuleState.description: A loaded module and whether it is enabled for the caller's project.

NotificationPost.title: NotificationPost
NotificationPost.description:
``POST /notifications/projects/{project_id}/notifications``.

No pin over the API: a pin is cleared by the action of the module that set it, and an
API caller has no such action.

NotificationSent.title: NotificationSent
NotificationSent.description: The stored notification and each channel's outcome.

PinUnlockRequest.title: PinUnlockRequest
PinUnlockRequest.description:
The PIN. The device's refresh token comes from the refresh cookie: both are
required, a PIN alone is never a credential.

PolygonGeoJSON.title: PolygonGeoJSON
PolygonGeoJSON.description: A GeoJSON ``Polygon`` in WGS84: ``[lon, lat]`` positions, exterior ring first.

PresignedRead.title: PresignedRead
PresignedRead.description: A request the client sends straight to object storage before ``expires_at``.

ProjectCreate.title: ProjectCreate
ProjectCreate.description: ``POST /projects``. The tenant comes from the token, never from the body.

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate
ProjectUpdate.description: ``PATCH /projects/{id}``: only the given fields change; ``spatial_bounds: null`` clears.

ResolvedColumn.title: ResolvedColumn
ResolvedColumn.description: A saved column as the register shows it; ``missing``: no longer in the catalogue.

SavedViewCreate.title: SavedViewCreate
SavedViewCreate.description:
``POST .../views`` (also "save as"). The owner is the caller; the project is the path's.

``team_id`` names the team of a ``team`` view and is given for no other visibility.
``is_default`` is allowed on ``private`` (the caller's default) and ``project`` (the
project default, Project Administrator only) views.

SavedViewRead.title: SavedViewRead
SavedViewRead.description:
A view as loaded: its configuration plus which referenced columns are missing.

``missing_columns`` lists every id (from columns, filter, sort, group-by) the register's
catalogue no longer has; the register skips them. It is empty when the register has
no catalogue registered (nothing can be checked).

SavedViewUpdate.title: SavedViewUpdate
SavedViewUpdate.description:
``PATCH .../views/{id}``: edit, rename, share, make default; only given fields change.

``filter``, ``group_by`` and ``team_id`` may be ``null`` (clears them). The register
of a view never changes.

refresh_expires_in.title: Refresh Expires In
refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds until the login session ends (sign-in + 12 h); then sign in again

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description:
The access token. The refresh token is never in a body: it is the ``httpOnly``
refresh cookie (diff §4.2, TD-203).

UploadCreate.title: UploadCreate
UploadCreate.description:
``POST /uploads/projects/{project_id}/files``: what the client is about to upload.

``sha256`` is the client's hex digest of the bytes; the server recomputes it before the
file becomes available. ``size_bytes`` is signed into the upload URL.

UploadTicket.title: UploadTicket
UploadTicket.description: The new file record and the presigned ``PUT`` for its bytes.
